en: Chapter Three
zh_TW: 第三章

en: Don't Answer for Me
zh_TW: 不准替我答應

en: Don't Answer for Me
zh_TW: 不准替我答應

en: The clapper is somewhere along the dry canal. Go to the edge and look
zh_TW: 鐘舌在乾運河那邊。走到岸邊看看

en: Get down in the drain by the bank and find out what it follows
zh_TW: 躲進岸邊的水溝，看清楚牠跟著什麼走

en: Not in the guide
zh_TW: 攻略沒有寫

en: The clapper is in an undertaker's chest. What does it follow? How fast?
zh_TW: 鐘舌在一隻送葬者的胸口。牠跟著什麼走？多快？

en: It follows a heartbeat: not fast, not slow, the same as a person's. We saw it ourselves, lying in a drain.
zh_TW: 牠跟著心跳走——不快不慢，跟人的心跳一樣。這是我們趴在水溝裡自己看到的。

en: Guide notes: one line left blank
zh_TW: 攻略筆記：這一條是空白

en: There.
zh_TW: 在那裡。

en: (The canal ran dry long ago. From an old hoist beam hung an undertaker, feet dangling over the drop, perfectly still. Something copper glowed in its chest.)
zh_TW: （運河早就乾了。一根舊吊樑下掛著一隻送葬者，腳懸在半空，一動也不動。牠胸口有一點銅色的光。）

en: The clapper.
zh_TW: 是鐘舌。

en: (The iron rod inside a bell, the one that strikes it. The one I pulled out. It fell into the crack, and that thing swallowed it.)
zh_TW: （鐘裡面那根撞鐘的鐵棒。我拆下來的那根。掉進裂縫之後，被牠吞了。）

en: I'll draw it off.
zh_TW: 我去引開牠。

en: No.
zh_TW: 不行。

en: If you're not saying anything, I'll take it you're thinking.
zh_TW: 你不說話，我就當你在想。

en: Then what's your plan?
zh_TW: 那你有什麼方案？

en: (I had nothing.)
zh_TW: （我說不出來。）

en: (I went through the whole guide in my head. Not one word about this undertaker.)
zh_TW: （我把攻略從頭翻了一遍。這隻送葬者，攻略裡一個字都沒有。）

en: (Misha crouched at the edge, measured with a length of wire for a long time, then took the bell box apart into six pieces.)
zh_TW: （彌夏蹲在渠邊，用鐵絲量了半天，把鐘箱拆成六片。）

en: What does it follow?
zh_TW: 牠跟著什麼走？

en: Heartbeats.
zh_TW: 心跳。

en: How fast?
zh_TW: 多快？

en: (The guide didn't say.)
zh_TW: （攻略沒有寫。）

en: Misha will make a fake heart at that speed
zh_TW: 彌夏要照那個速度做一顆假心臟

en: Guide notes: you wrote one line yourself
zh_TW: 攻略筆記：自己寫下一條

en: (We crawled into the drain by the bank and lay flat in the cold mud. It hung right in front of us, half turned away.)
zh_TW: （我們爬進岸邊的水溝，趴在冰冷的爛泥裡。牠就掛在前面，側身背對著我們。）

en: If it follows heartbeats, we'll give it one.
zh_TW: 牠跟著心跳走，那就給牠一個心跳。

en: (Misha pushed a copper plate from the bell box into the mud. Sheila wrapped a small stone in cloth, tied it to a string, and let it hang in front of the plate.)
zh_TW: （彌夏把鐘箱拆下來的一片銅片插在泥裡。席菈用布包住一顆小石頭，繫在線上，垂到銅片前。）

en: How fast?
zh_TW: 多快？

en: Again. How fast?
zh_TW: 再一次。多快？

en: We've got all night. How fast?
zh_TW: 我們有一整夜。多快？

en: Very slow.
zh_TW: 很慢。

en: A little slow.
zh_TW: 慢一點。

en: Not fast, not slow.
zh_TW: 不快不慢。

en: A little fast.
zh_TW: 快一點。

en: Very fast.
zh_TW: 很快。

en: Uneven.
zh_TW: 忽快忽慢。

en: (Sheila began to knock. Thud... thud... Cloth-wrapped stone on copper, a dull sound.)
zh_TW: （席菈開始敲。咚……咚……布包著的石頭敲在銅片上，聲音悶悶的。）

en: (It didn't move at all. Only the copper glow in its chest kept its own pace.)
zh_TW: （牠一動也不動。只有胸口的銅光，照自己的速度一下一下地亮。）

en: (Its head tilted a little, then stopped. As if it heard something but wasn't sure.)
zh_TW: （牠的頭偏了一點——又停住了。像是聽到了，但不確定。）

en: (The chain shivered once, then went still. It wasn't following the sound.)
zh_TW: （鏈子抖了一下，又靜下來。牠跟的不是聲音。）

en: (The chain rattled first. Then it turned its head, the frost-light in its hood fixed on the copper plate. The glow in its chest began to beat with Sheila's hand.)
zh_TW: （鏈子先響了一聲。然後牠轉過頭，兜帽裡的霜光直直對著銅片。胸口的銅光，跟著席菈的手一起亮。）

en: Try again.
zh_TW: 再試一次。

en: That's the one.
zh_TW: 就是這個速度。

en: ...Same as a person's heartbeat.
zh_TW: ……跟人的心跳一樣快。

en: (When Sheila stopped, it kept staring at the copper plate for a long time.)
zh_TW: （席菈停手之後，牠還對著銅片看了很久。）

en: Give me one night. I'll make one that beats at that speed.
zh_TW: 給我一晚。我照這個速度，做一顆會跳的。

en: (Under the blank line in my guide notes, I wrote one line myself. The first one I didn't remember. We saw it ourselves.)
zh_TW: （我在攻略筆記那條空白底下，自己寫了一行。這是第一條不是我記得的，是我們自己看到的。）

en: Lower the fake heart from the bank, one spot at a time, and lead it into the sluice
zh_TW: 從岸上把假心臟垂到河床，一段一段把牠引進閘道

en: Lower the heart past the sluice. When it's right under the coal cart, cut the rope
zh_TW: 把假心臟垂到閘道另一邊；牠走到煤車正下方時，割斷繩子

en: (The fifth night. Misha hadn't slept. Her fingers were covered in copper filings.)
zh_TW: （第五夜。彌夏一整晚沒睡，手指上全是銅屑。）

en: Done.
zh_TW: 做好了。

en: (She opened her hand. A small copper box was beating in her palm, thud by thud, as fast as Sheila had knocked last night.)
zh_TW: （她攤開手。一個小銅盒在她掌心裡一下一下地跳，跟昨晚席菈敲的一樣快。）

en: Tie it to a cord and lower it from the bank. It can't hear far. Too far and it won't move.
zh_TW: 綁在繩子上，從岸上垂下去。牠聽得到的距離不遠，太遠牠不會動。

en: Once it reaches it, pull it up and move on. A stretch at a time, all the way into the sluice.
zh_TW: 牠走到了，就收起來，換下一個地方。一段一段，帶進閘道。

en: There's only the one. Don't lose it.
zh_TW: 只有這一顆。別弄丟了。

en: Press {key} — lower the fake heart
zh_TW: 按 {key}　把假心臟垂下去

en: Press {key} — pull the fake heart up
zh_TW: 按 {key}　把假心臟收上來

en: (It didn't move. Too far. It can't hear it.)
zh_TW: （牠沒有動。太遠了，牠聽不到。）

en: (The chains gave. It dropped onto the canal bed and turned toward the beating.)
zh_TW: （鏈子鬆了。牠掉到河床上，轉向那個心跳。）

en: (It turned toward me. Restoring makes my heart race. It can hear that.)
zh_TW: （牠轉向我了。重現的時候我的心跳會變快——牠聽得到。）

en: (It stopped at the mouth of the sluice, head bowed, listening.)
zh_TW: （牠停在閘道口，低著頭，在聽。）

en: It's pinned under the coal. The clapper is in its chest
zh_TW: 煤壓住了牠。鐘舌就在牠的胸口

en: (On the timber frame above the sluice sat a cart heaped with coal. A rope ran from its tail to a post on the east bank.)
zh_TW: （閘道上方的木架上，停著一台堆滿煤的車。車尾一條繩子，拉到東岸的木柱上綁著。）

en: Cut the rope and the whole cart tips over.
zh_TW: 繩子一斷，整車煤就倒下去。

en: Only when it's right underneath. Too early and it misses. Too late and it only gets the frame.
zh_TW: 要等牠走到正下方。太早砸不到，太晚只砸到鐵架。

en: Lower the heart on the far side of the sluice. It'll walk right under.
zh_TW: 把心臟垂到閘道另一邊。牠會從底下走過去。

en: (I looked at the rope. There was nothing about this in the guide.)
zh_TW: （我看著那條繩子。攻略裡沒有這一段。）

en: Press {key} — cut the rope
zh_TW: 按 {key}　割斷繩子

en: (The whole cart tipped. Coal poured down and buried most of it.)
zh_TW: （整車煤傾下去，壓住了牠大半個身子。）

en: (Too early. The coal landed in front of it. It climbed over the heap and shook itself free—)
zh_TW: （太早了。煤落在牠前面——牠爬過煤堆，掙脫了。）

en: (Too late. The coal only caught its frame. It tore itself loose—)
zh_TW: （太晚了。煤只砸到牠背後的鐵架——牠掙脫了。）

en: On the way back, Misha has something to say
zh_TW: 回程的路上，彌夏有話要說

en: (Sheila looped the rope twice around her waist, knotted it, and pushed the other end into my hands.)
zh_TW: （席菈把繩子在腰上繞了兩圈、打了個結，另一頭塞進我手裡。）

en: I'm going down. You hold on.
zh_TW: 我下去。你抓著。

en: Sword in my left hand. The right one's for the thing in its chest.
zh_TW: 左手拿劍。右手要抓牠胸口那根東西。

en: That heap won't hold for long. Hurry.
zh_TW: 煤堆撐不了多久。快。

en: (Don't let go. Whichever way she swings, pull the other way.)
zh_TW: （按住別放。她往哪邊晃，就往反方向拉。）

en: (The moment her hand closed on the clapper, the coal heap gave way. The rope snapped taut. Misha threw herself onto the end of it—and the three of us went down in the mud.)
zh_TW: （她抓到鐘舌的那一刻，煤堆塌了。繩子猛地一緊，彌夏撲過來壓住繩尾——我們三個人一起摔在泥裡。）

en: (Sheila lay on her back and held the clapper up high.)
zh_TW: （席菈仰躺著，把鐘舌高高舉起。）

en: Expert.
zh_TW: 高手。

en: Hm?
zh_TW: 嗯？

en: Next time, you're the one hanging upside down.
zh_TW: 下次換你倒吊。

en: (I laughed. I laughed until everything that hurt started to throb.)
zh_TW: （我笑了，笑到身上的傷一抽一抽地痛。）

en: Press {key} — take hold of Sheila's rope
zh_TW: 按 {key}　抓住席菈的繩子

en: Hold {key} — keep her steady (left / right to stop the swing)
zh_TW: 按住 {key}　拉住繩子（左右修正擺盪）

en: (She swung into the iron frame—)
zh_TW: （她撞到鐵架了——）

en: Mud in the Dry Canal
zh_TW: 乾運河的泥

en: Sheila went down head-first for the clapper. I held the rope on the bank.
zh_TW: 席菈倒吊下去拿鐘舌，我在岸上抓著繩子。

en: When the coal heap gave way, all three of us went down in the mud. She lay on her back and held the clapper up high. "Expert." "Hm?" "Next time, you're the one hanging upside down." I laughed. The first time I'd laughed since I came to this world.
zh_TW: 煤堆塌下來的時候，我們三個人一起摔進泥裡。她仰躺著，把鐘舌舉得高高的。「高手。」「嗯？」「下次換你倒吊。」我笑了。來到這個世界以後，第一次笑。

en: I still remember the smell of the mud. I can't remember why I laughed.
zh_TW: 泥的味道還在。為什麼笑，想不起來了。
